t: You're at St James's Church in Clerkenwell, an Anglican parish church. It's known for the writers buried here. Among them are the Elizabethan and Jacobean playwrights Thomas Dekker, Thomas Heywood and William Rowley. Heywood claimed a hand in two hundred and twenty plays, and his best-known work is A Woman Killed with Kindness. Also buried here are Gilbert Burnet, the Bishop of Salisbury and historian, who was a close friend of King William III, and the mathematician and theologian John Craig.
